text:
Hang all fourteen shards. The ring knows its own law.

The hasp — your hoard, one shard off every lock you opened

0 of fourteen sockets hang full

Take the ring apart
Close the ring

Tap a shard, then tap a socket — or drag it there. The iron rivet at the top is slot 0, and the ring runs sunwise from it.
